panels.title: Retry loops by stage (edge_taken)
panels.description: How often each stage sent work back — where the factory churns.

targets.rawSql: SELECT payload->>'from' AS stage, payload->>'edge' AS edge, count(*) AS loops FROM events WHERE type='edge_taken' GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 3 DESC

SELECT r.ticket_title AS run, e.payload->>'from' AS from_stage, e.payload->>'to' AS to_stage, count(*) AS times, max((e.payload->>'max')::int) AS cap FROM events e JOIN runs r ON r.run_id=e.run_id WHERE e.type='edge_taken' GROUP BY 1,2,3 ORDER BY times DESC

SELECT payload->>'stage_id' AS stage, max((payload->>'iteration')::int) AS max_iteration, count(*) FILTER (WHERE (payload->>'iteration')::int > 1) AS retries FROM events WHERE type='stage_started' GROUP BY 1 HAVING count(*) FILTER (WHERE (payload->>'iteration')::int > 1) > 0 ORDER BY retries DESC
SELECT r.ticket_title AS run, e.payload->>'stalled_at' AS stalled_at, e.payload->>'reason' AS reason FROM events e JOIN runs r ON r.run_id=e.run_id WHERE e.type='run_abandoned' ORDER BY e.ts DESC
